name: seo-competitor-backlink-gap
summary: Compare a target domain with explicitly selected competitors using approved backlink evidence and route plausible authority opportunities.
inputs: market, target pages, date range, and comparison scope
writes: Home.md review link when review is required
approval_gates: external_read: ask before live competitor/provider, Common Crawl, publisher, or external page reads unless explicitly approved in the current workflow
provider_data: paid or credentialed calls require applicable approval
vault_write: save only to a resolved project, client, or prospect context when authorized
outreach: contact or pitch actions require a separate approved workflow
external_mutation: competitor contact, outreach, link acquisition, CMS, code, publishing, provider configuration, and production are out of scope
done_when: target and competitors are explicitly named and comparison scope is clear
provider status, freshness, source, and sample limits are recorded
shared and distinct patterns are source-labeled
provider metrics are not treated as complete or causal ranking evidence
opportunities have relevance, destination, evidence, effort, risk, and owner
no competitor scraping/contact, copied assets, spam, paid-link, exchange, private-network, or guaranteed-outcome recommendation is present
durable artifact uses project/client/prospect routing and review frontmatter
seo-quality-gate passes or is explicitly deferred with an actionable reason
verification: verify unavailable providers produced no fabricated comparisons
verify no competitor contact, outreach, link acquisition, or production mutation occurred
verify changed Markdown/frontmatter and Home review registration when applicable
